svg.title: A LEO pass: carrier-to-noise density against the GNSS sky
svg.desc: One low-Earth-orbit (LEO) pass from a real run of the leo-pass kind (leo-pass-iridium.toml, engine run by this generator): Iridium-pass at 781 km, STL band at 1621 MHz, seen by an air user at 50° N 30° W. Above the 5° mask for 750 s, maximum elevation 65.0° at 444 s. Carrier-to-noise density peaks at 80.5 dB-Hz (median 71.3), 34.3 dB above the GNSS median of 46.2 dB-Hz from 8 GPS satellites in view (38.2 to 51.1 dB-Hz); Doppler reaches 35.4 kHz.
